items.title: File Einspruch against Grundsteuerwert assessment
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch beim Finanzamt Musterweilburg eingelegt werden, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter states a separate posting date (Aufgabe zur Post): Saturday 21.11.2026 — this stated posting day controls delivery fiction, not the Bescheid date (18.11.2026). Since it is a Finanzamt letter posted after 1 Jan 2025, delivery is deemed on the 4th day after posting (§122 Abs.2 Nr.1 AO), and for tax offices this deemed-delivery day itself moves to the next working day if it falls on a weekend/holiday (§108 Abs.3 AO). Counting from Sat 21.11.2026 (day of posting, not counted): +1=Sun 22.11, +2=Mon 23.11, +3=Tue 24.11, +4=Wed 25.11.2026. 25.11.2026 is a Wednesday, a normal working day, so deemed delivery = 25.11.2026. The one-month Einspruch period (§355 Abs.1 AO, counted per §108 Abs.1 AO/§188 Abs.2 BGB) runs from the day after delivery and ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number: 25.12.2026. However 25.12.2026 (Christmas Day) and 26.12.2026 (2nd Christmas Day) are nationwide public holidays, and 27.12.2026 is a Sunday; the period therefore extends to the next working day, Monday 28.12.2026 (§108 Abs.3 AO).

warnings: The letter only fixes the Grundsteuerwert (property tax value) at 184,300 €; it does not itself demand any payment — the actual Grundsteuer will be set later by the municipality based on a separate Grundsteuermessbescheid, so no payment amount or due date could be derived from this letter.

The letter footer lists an IBAN (DE36 5135 0025 0003 3001 00) under a generic 'Landesmusterbank' label even though no payment is requested in this letter; verify independently before ever using this IBAN for any payment to this office.
